name: io.github.yuluo688/gen-image-mcp
title: gen-image MCP
description: Local stdio MCP for OpenAI-compatible and Gemini image generation, editing, and model fallback.

environmentVariables.name: GEN_IMAGE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full HTTP/HTTPS base URL for the configured image API provider.

environmentVariables.name: GEN_IMAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the configured image API provider.

environmentVariables.name: GEN_IMAGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated OpenAI Images API model list. Configure this or GEN_IMAGE_GEMINI_MODEL.

environmentVariables.name: GEN_IMAGE_GEMINI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated Gemini image model list. Configure this or GEN_IMAGE_MODEL.

environmentVariables.name: GEN_IMAGE_AUTO_FALLBACK
environmentVariables.description: Optional true/false switch for sequential model fallback.

environmentVariables.name: GEN_IMAGE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-request upstream timeout in milliseconds; defaults to 120000. Positive integer, maximum 2147483647.
